fingerprint_summary: NYS GIS Clearinghouse statewide public tax-parcel ArcGIS layer (NYS_Tax_Parcels_Public FeatureServer, layer 1). Greene County opted into public sharing — COUNTY_NAME='Greene' returns 38,418 parcels with full assessment attributes. Open REST query API.
recommended_adapter: scrapers/parcel_master.py — ArcGIS bulk pull via the scaffold/scrapers/_arcgis_featureserver.py helper
known_limitations: Enrichment only — never originates a lead
NYS public layer carries no exemption columns — exempt_* flags are not populated
Assessment data lags clerk recordings on ownership/transfer timing
Layer is refreshed annually by NYS (2024-2025 roll data)
